metadata.title: fix(csrf): bind CSRF tokens to user sessions and improve admin UI auth flow
metadata.author: rakdutta

description:
This PR strengthens CSRF protection in the admin UI by binding tokens to authenticated user sessions and synchronizing token generation with the JWT authentication flow.

  Key Changes:
  
  - Session-bound CSRF tokens: Refactored _set_admin_csrf_cookie to generate HMAC-based tokens using user_id and session_id (JWT jti), ensuring tokens are cryptographically tied to the authenticated session
  - Authentication flow integration: Store JWT jti in request.state during login and use it for consistent CSRF token generation across the request lifecycle
  - Dedicated /admin/ route: Added unauthenticated endpoint that generates and sets CSRF cookies before admin UI loads, using current identity if available
  - Frontend consistency: Unified auth header handling via getAuthHeaders and updated fetchWithTimeout to always include credentials for proper cookie handling
  - Enhanced logging: Added debug-level logging throughout CSRF middleware for token validation steps, aiding diagnostics without exposing secrets

  The changes resolve token mismatch issues during admin token creation while maintaining the security model where CSRF tokens validate against the session that created them.

  Closes #4712

commits.message:
fix(tokens): resolve CSRF validation on admin token creation

Generate and set CSRF tokens when serving the admin UI (/admin/ route),
ensuring both JWT and CSRF token cookies are available for subsequent
POST requests. This fixes the "CSRF validation failed" error when
creating tokens through the admin UI.

Changes:
- Add /admin/ route with CSRF token generation for authenticated users
- Extract user identity from request state or JWT cookie fallback
- Include credentials in fetchWithTimeout for proper cookie handling
- Refactor token creation to use getAuthHeaders for consistent auth handling

Fixes #4712

commits.message:
fix(csrf): add /admin/ route for unauthenticated CSRF token generation and improve debug logging

## Summary

Fixed the "Failed to create token: CSRF validation failed" error in the admin UI by ensuring CSRF tokens are properly generated and set when users access the `/admin/` page.

## Changes

1. **Added `/admin/` route** (main.py):
   - Generates CSRF tokens for authenticated users accessing the admin page
   - Handles both authenticated request state and fallback JWT token extraction from cookies
   - Sets CSRF cookie with proper security settings via `set_csrf_cookie()`
   - Ensures CSRF tokens are available regardless of authentication method (Bearer token or JWT cookie)

2. **Enhanced CSRF validation logging** (csrf_middleware.py):
   - Added info logs for successful double-submit validation
   - Added info logs for successful HMAC validation
   - Improved warning logs with token prefixes and session IDs for debugging
   - Helps diagnose timing issues or token generation mismatches

## Testing

- Verified curl-based token creation succeeds with 201 Created
- CSRF cookie is properly set when accessing `/admin/` with admin JWT
- CSRF token validation passes for subsequent POST requests
- Test payload: {"name":"test123","expires_in_days":30,"tags":[],"team_id":null,"scope":{...}}

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
